packages.name: EthOS Backup Manager
packages.description: Versioned backups for folders and Docker Compose projects. Dated hardlink snapshots, GFS retention, quick/deep verify, a restore wizard and optional rclone offsite replication — in a native EthOS window.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: legacy generations show their real size and file count after indexing; unknown sizes render as — instead of 0 B. 1.0.1: the window now uses the shared AntiVirus/Domains shell — 218 px rail, text-only nav, panels, summary tiles, tables, tag pills and the same light/dark tokens. 1.0.0: first release — dated rsync hardlink snapshots, 7/4/6 GFS retention, completion manifest, quick and deep verify, cancel and queued runs, restore in place or to another folder, Docker Compose project discovery with volume/image snapshots, and rclone mirror with 30-day remote history.

packages.name: Domains
packages.description: Reverse proxy with free, automatically renewed HTTPS certificates. Point your own domains at this NAS and forward them to any host and port - another device, a container, or EthOS itself - without touching nginx by hand. Caddy issues and renews Let's Encrypt certificates on its own, and the stack keeps routing even when EthOS is restarting.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.2.0: the window follows the AntiVirus layout — a left rail with Overview, Routes, Certificates, Settings and Diagnostics, status pills, stat tiles and action cards. Routes show their options as chips, the form keeps headers/Host/streaming under Advanced, and the ACME email field is no longer overwritten by the background refresh. 1.1.1: read certificates from Caddy's actual storage root (/data/caddy/certificates), so the certificate list and expiry show up. per-route response headers and permanent redirects, plus a bulk route import so an existing proxy configuration (for example Nginx Proxy Manager) can be migrated in one step. 1.0.0: initial release: Caddy-based reverse proxy with automatic Let's Encrypt certificates, per-domain routes to any host:port (including EthOS itself), WebSocket and streaming support, live certificate expiry, a DNS preflight check and the proxy log in one native EthOS window.

packages.name: EthOS AntiVirus
packages.description: ClamAV antivirus with a native EthOS window: full, custom and scheduled scans, quarantine copies, scan logs and configurable scan options. Read-only scans of /home, /mnt and /media; signatures update automatically.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.1.4: Browse… in the scan target and schedule forms uses the EthOS folder picker, restricted to /home, /mnt and /media. 2.1.3: health/status report which shares are visible in the scanner container and the UI warns instead of failing scans silently. 2.1.2: fix scans failing with 'not visible in the scanner container' — the UI container now mounts /home, /mnt and /media read-only at /scan. 2.1.1: light and dark themes follow the EthOS appearance toggle. 2.1.0: Synology-style options — quarantine copies, whitelist/file-type/size filters, smart scan, scan log, scheduled scans, definition info and a persistent package data volume. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; package service bound to loopback and reached through an authenticated proxy. 1.0.1: clearer first-start status and longer scan timeout.

packages.name: EthOS Welcome
packages.description: A tiny static welcome page for your NAS, served by nginx on port 8090.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: light and dark themes, honours the ?theme= passed by EthOS and falls back to prefers-color-scheme. 1.0.1: Package Center icon. 1.0.0: initial release: static welcome page with a live clock.

packages.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
packages.description: A tiny two-player tic-tac-toe game that opens directly in an EthOS window. No container, no port.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.1.0: light and dark themes follow the EthOS appearance toggle. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; no nginx container and no port. 1.0.0: initial nginx version.

packages.name: EthOS VM Manager
packages.description: Run Windows and Linux virtual machines on this NAS with hardware acceleration. Create a VM from an ISO, boot it, and use it from the browser console - no separate computer left running. Disks live on your own shares, VMs start again after a restart, and every VM is isolated in its own process.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: the console overlay no longer covers the window — it is hidden until you press Console, so the machine list and the create form are always visible. 1.0.1: the browser console connects again — the WebSocket handshake now selects the `binary` subprotocol noVNC asks for, which browsers otherwise reject. Port 8094 shows a short explanation instead of raw JSON when opened directly, the create form pre-fills a real storage root, and picking a folder fills the ISO list automatically. 1.0.0: first release. KVM virtual machines with a browser console: create a VM from an ISO stored on the NAS, start, stop and reset it, follow its live status, and let it start automatically with EthOS. Disks are qcow2 files on a share you pick. Snapshots, cloning and OVA export follow in 1.1.
